definitions.full: H1579. Gimzo גִּמְזוֺ proper name, of a location (compare Syriac (Lexicons) sycamore ; Arabic is loan-word Frä 140 ; compare Assyrian proper name, of a location Gamuzanu Pinches Hebraica. July, 1886, 222 ), city of Judah toward Philistines 2Chr 28:18 ; modern Jimzu , east from Lydda Rob BR ii. 249 Bd Pal 21 .
